title: Charcoal Types Course
note: A 12-module charcoal drawing course sold to African art students, hobbyists and vocational trainees, delivered online with a starter art kit.

startup.item: Charcoal art kit (willow, vine, compressed, pencils, powder)
Blending stumps, erasers, fixative and accessories
Phone tripod and clip-on light for filming lessons
Laptop or tablet for course hosting
Branding, logo and landing page design
Course platform setup and domain (first year)
